scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: mise trust && mise install && (cd backend && mise exec -- pnpm install) && (cd web && mise exec -- pnpm install)

scripts.name: Run Backend
scripts.command: cd backend && mise exec -- pnpm install && (test -f .env || echo 'ADMIN_TOKEN=local-admin' > .env) && mise exec -- pnpm exec void db migrate && mise exec -- pnpm dev

scripts.name: Run Web
scripts.command: cd web && mise exec -- pnpm install && mise exec -- pnpm dev

scripts.name: List Contribution Requests
scripts.command: cd backend && DSMOD_ADMIN_TOKEN=local-admin mise exec -- pnpm -s dsctl list

scripts.name: Reset Backend Database
scripts.command: cd backend && mise exec -- pnpm exec void db reset

scripts.name: Game Tests
scripts.command: cd mod && mise exec -- ./gradlew runClientGameTest runProdClientGameTest
